The school garden is one of the best places in the city. Both of them like rice and tea. Last Friday, Eva and Nina went to the school garden. In fact, cricket nets frame the sports field.
Eva learned a lot about math. Eva borrowed a book about math from the museum. There are always many people at the classroom. The children made castles in the sand.
Eva and Nina had great fun there. Eva plays badminton with Nina every Friday. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Also, reading builds knowledge day by day.
Eva wants to be a teacher in the future. Life is full of small surprises. They took many photos at the classroom.
